Dashboard: One Toolbar, the Live Cards, a Logical Order

The proposed website Dashboard, 6 Oct 2026, branch feat/dashboard-audit-fixes. Before is commit a5779d1e; After is this change. Every figure, label and title is unchanged. Order: the Department's figures (Scholarships, Hostels, Year by Year Trends, Year on Year Report), then the portals' (Dashboards by Portal, State/UT-wise Figures).

Toolbar and summary panel

Before
Three stacked rows of controls before the first figure: a lone Officer Login, the State/UT picker, then nine Type of Applicant chips over two rows. Panel figures were plain text
After
One toolbar row: Type of Applicant as a dropdown, State / UT and Officer Login on one baseline, all 40px tall. Panel figures 9 Cr, 11 Cr and 14,757 are links (↓) to their cards
Why
The chips were the busiest line on the page, for a choice most readers never make. The panel figures repeat the cards on purpose: summary above, detail below.

Scholarships and Fellowship

Before
Our re-arranged cards: a lead figure, two small figures, a sentence and a trend line in each
After
The live page's own cards: coloured header band, tinted body, its three figures in its order, as on dosje.gov.in
Why
You asked for the live structure intact; the rebuilt cards read busier than the live ones.

Hostels and Top Class Education

Before
Our cards: lead figures side by side, a sentence and trend line on one, empty space under two
After
The live cards: title with icon at the right, capitalised labels over figures, Schools and Colleges side by side with their chips and fund released
Why
Same reason; the live layout also fills each card evenly.

Year by Year Trends (with Share of Fund Release)

Before
The students chart alone across the page; Share of Fund Release separately, lower down, as a list of bars
After
As the live page groups them: the students chart and the Share of Fund Release ring side by side
Why
Live structure kept, and a full-width ring on its own was 550px across.

Fund section

Before
"Fund Release and Expenditure" holding only Share of Fund Release for a citizen
After
For a citizen: no separate section (the ring is under Year by Year Trends). For an officer: "Expenditure Against Budget Estimate", the spending chart alone
Why
The spending figures are post-login KPIs; an empty-looking section is not drawn.

Dashboards by Portal (now after the Department's sections)

Before
Between Hostels and the trends; three cards of equal width with the NMBA map squeezed into a third
After
With the State/UT map, after all the Department's sections. NMBA takes the row (map and figures side by side); SMILE – Beggary and Senior Citizens Welfare share the next. Every secondary figure uses the live cards' style: capitalised label over the figure
Why
Grouped by who publishes the figures; the map gets room; one figure style across every card.

Phone, top of the dashboard (390px)

Before
Type of Applicant as a dropdown already on phone; summary panel without links
After
Same controls, with Officer Login beside State / UT; panel figures link to their cards
Why
One control set at every width.
